payout_quote: Recycle any ink or toner cartridge, up to 10 per calendar month per customer, and, if the member has spent at least $30 in ink and/or toner purchases at Staples over the previous 180 days, the member will receive $2 back in Staples Rewards per cartridge.
steps: Join Staples Rewards (free) and spend at least $30 on ink/toner at Staples in the prior 180 days
Collect empty ink or toner cartridges (any brand recycled; rewards on up to 10 per calendar month)
Drop cartridges at any Staples store or print a free UPS shipping label and mail them in
Receive $2 in Staples Rewards per cartridge, issued online monthly
catches: Payout is Staples Rewards store credit, not cash — spendable only at Staples.
Requires $30 in Staples ink/toner purchases in the previous 180 days to earn anything; without that spend you get $0.
Capped at 10 cartridges ($20) per calendar month; extra cartridges recycle for free with no reward.
biggest_catch: Pays $2/cartridge in Staples store credit (not cash), capped at $20/month, and only if you already spent $30+ on Staples ink/toner in the last 180 days.
eligibility: Staples Rewards members who spent $30+ on ink/toner at Staples in the prior 180 days.
timing: Ink Recycling Rewards issued online monthly, separate from the standard Rewards statement.
